questionText: ACROSS: A word meaning very large or huge (4 letters): V_S_
explanation: VAST means very large in size. V-A-S-T. It means extremely great in area or amount.

questionText: DOWN: Opposite of rough or harsh (6 letters): _M_O_H
explanation: SMOOTH means having an even surface without roughness. S-M-O-O-T-H. It is the opposite of rough.

questionText: Fill in the blank: A word for a person who studies rocks and minerals: G _ _ L _ G _ _ T
explanation: A GEOLOGIST studies rocks, minerals, and the structure of the earth. G-E-O-L-O-G-I-S-T.

questionText: Word ladder: Change COLD to WARM in four steps changing one letter at a time. What is the second word? COLD - _OLD - _ORM - WARM
explanation: COLD to BOLD (change C to B) to BORM is not right. The intended path is COLD - BOLD - BORM - WARM. BOLD changes C to B.

questionText: ACROSS: A formal agreement between countries (6 letters): T _ _ A _ Y
explanation: A TREATY is a formally concluded agreement between countries. T-R-E-A-T-Y.

questionText: Which word completes the crossword clue: The study of living organisms (7 letters): B _ O L _ G Y
explanation: BIOLOGY is the study of living organisms. B-I-O-L-O-G-Y.

questionText: DOWN: A tropical bird known for repeating words (6 letters): P _ R _ O _
explanation: PARROT is a tropical bird known for its ability to mimic human speech. P-A-R-R-O-T.

questionText: Fill in: A word meaning to make better or more attractive: E _ H _ N _ E
explanation: ENHANCE means to intensify or improve in value or quality. E-N-H-A-N-C-E.

questionText: ACROSS: The outermost layer of the Earth (5 letters): C _ U _ T
explanation: The CRUST is the outermost solid shell of the Earth. C-R-U-S-T.

questionText: Word association: Which word connects FIRE, PLACE, and WORK?
explanation: SIDE connects them: FIRESIDE, SIDEPLACE is incorrect. The answer is PLACE: FIREPLACE, WORKPLACE. Actually WORK: FIREWORK, FRAMEWORK. Best answer: C connects to make FIRESIDE, SIDEPLACE, SIDEWORK.

questionText: DOWN: A feeling of great happiness (7 letters): E _ S T _ S _
explanation: ECSTASY means an overwhelming feeling of great happiness. E-C-S-T-A-S-Y.

questionText: Fill in: A word for a long journey especially by sea: V _ _ A G _
explanation: VOYAGE means a long journey involving travel by sea or in space. V-O-Y-A-G-E.

questionText: ACROSS: The act of giving up a throne (10 letters): A _ D _ C _ T _ O N
explanation: ABDICATION means the act of renouncing the throne or giving up power. A-B-D-I-C-A-T-I-O-N.

questionText: Which picture clue would represent the word ARCHIPELAGO?
explanation: ARCHIPELAGO is a chain or cluster of islands. The picture of multiple islands in a body of water represents this word.

questionText: DOWN: A person who studies the stars and planets (10 letters): A _ T _ O N _ M _ R
explanation: An ASTRONOMER is a scientist who studies celestial objects. A-S-T-R-O-N-O-M-E-R.

questionText: Fill in: A word meaning impossible to penetrate or pass through: I _ P _ N _ T _ _ B _ E
explanation: IMPENETRABLE means impossible to enter or pass through. I-M-P-E-N-E-T-R-A-B-L-E.

questionText: ACROSS: A period of ten years (6 letters): D _ C _ D _
explanation: A DECADE is a period of ten years. D-E-C-A-D-E.

questionText: Word game: Which word can precede STORM, FALL, and DROP to make compound words?
explanation: RAIN can precede these: RAINSTORM, RAINFALL, RAINDROP. All are common compound words.

questionText: DOWN: The branch of science dealing with forces and motion (9 letters): M _ C _ A N _ C S
explanation: MECHANICS is the branch of physics concerned with motion and forces. M-E-C-H-A-N-I-C-S.

questionText: Fill in: A word meaning the right to vote: S _ _ F _ _ G E
explanation: SUFFRAGE is the right to vote in political elections. S-U-F-F-R-A-G-E.

questionText: ACROSS: A place where books are kept for borrowing (7 letters): L _ B _ A _ Y
explanation: A LIBRARY is a place where books and other resources are kept for use by the public. L-I-B-R-A-R-Y.

questionText: Which image would a crossword clue PENINSULA describe?
options: A) A long narrow piece of land surrounded by water on three sides
B) A region completely surrounded by water
C) A large body of land
explanation: A PENINSULA is a piece of land almost surrounded by water and connected to the mainland. India is an example of a peninsula.

questionText: DOWN: A type of government by the people (9 letters): D _ M _ C _ A C Y
explanation: DEMOCRACY is a system of government in which power is held by the people. D-E-M-O-C-R-A-C-Y.

questionText: Fill in: A word meaning to formally prohibit: P _ O H _ B _ T
explanation: PROHIBIT means to formally forbid by law or rule. P-R-O-H-I-B-I-T.

questionText: Word game: What word can follow BOOK, EYE, and HAND to make compound words?
explanation: MARK follows these: BOOKMARK, EYEMARK is not common. Better answer is CASE: BOOKCASE, EYECASE, HANDCASE. MARK makes BOOKMARK - the most common compound.

questionText: ACROSS: The process by which plants make food using sunlight (13 letters): P _ O T _ S _ N T H _ S _ S
explanation: PHOTOSYNTHESIS is the process by which plants use sunlight to make food. P-H-O-T-O-S-Y-N-T-H-E-S-I-S.

questionText: DOWN: A scientist who studies weather and climate (14 letters): M _ T _ O _ O L _ G _ S T
explanation: A METEOROLOGIST is a scientist who studies the atmosphere and weather. M-E-T-E-O-R-O-L-O-G-I-S-T.

questionText: Fill in: A word meaning the ability to read and write: L _ T _ R _ C Y
explanation: LITERACY is the ability to read and write. L-I-T-E-R-A-C-Y.

questionText: ACROSS: Great pain or distress (6 letters): A _ G _ I S H
explanation: ANGUISH means severe mental or physical pain. A-N-G-U-I-S-H.

questionText: Word scramble: Unscramble YAOCIVBULR to find a word related to language.
explanation: VOCABULARY is the collection of words used in a language. The scrambled letters YAOCIVBULR rearrange to VOCABULARY.

questionText: DOWN: The crime of making false statements under oath (7 letters): P _ R J _ R Y
explanation: PERJURY is the offense of willfully telling an untruth in court under oath. P-E-R-J-U-R-Y.

questionText: Fill in: A word meaning to completely destroy: A _ N _ H _ L A T E
explanation: ANNIHILATE means to completely destroy. A-N-N-I-H-I-L-A-T-E.

questionText: ACROSS: The quality of being honest and having strong moral principles (9 letters): I _ T _ G _ I T Y
explanation: INTEGRITY means the quality of being honest and having strong moral principles. I-N-T-E-G-R-I-T-Y.

questionText: Which word can follow OVER, OUT, and UNDER to form compound words?
explanation: WORK follows: OVERWORK, OUTWORK, UNDERWORK - all are valid compound words.

questionText: DOWN: A word meaning to make something less severe (9 letters): A _ E L _ O _ A T E
explanation: AMELIORATE means to make something bad or unsatisfactory better. A-M-E-L-I-O-R-A-T-E.

questionText: Fill in: A word meaning study of human societies and cultures: A _ T H _ O P _ L _ G Y
explanation: ANTHROPOLOGY is the study of human societies and cultures and their development. A-N-T-H-R-O-P-O-L-O-G-Y.

questionText: ACROSS: The layer of gas surrounding a planet (10 letters): A _ M O S P _ E R E
explanation: ATMOSPHERE is the layer of gases surrounding a planet. A-T-M-O-S-P-H-E-R-E.

questionText: Word game: What word connects HAND, FOOT, and BOOK?
explanation: PRINT connects: HANDPRINT, FOOTPRINT, BOOKPRINT is less common. The best connection is PRINT: HANDPRINT, FOOTPRINT.

questionText: DOWN: A formal speech given to an audience (7 letters): O _ A T _ O N
explanation: An ORATION is a formal speech especially one given on a ceremonial occasion. O-R-A-T-I-O-N.

questionText: Fill in: A device for measuring temperature: T _ E _ M _ M _ T E R
explanation: A THERMOMETER is an instrument for measuring temperature. T-H-E-R-M-O-M-E-T-E-R.

questionText: ACROSS: The study of past events (7 letters): H _ S T _ R Y
explanation: HISTORY is the study of past events. H-I-S-T-O-R-Y.

questionText: Which word can precede GUARD, BOARD, and PAPER to form compound words?
explanation: CARD connects: CARDGUARD, CARDBOARD, CARDPAPER. Actually BODYGUARD, SURFBOARD - BACK: BACKBOARD, BACKPAPER. CARD: CARDBOARD is the most common compound.

questionText: DOWN: A word meaning a strong feeling of enthusiasm (4 letters): Z _ A L
explanation: ZEAL means great energy or enthusiasm in pursuit of a cause. Z-E-A-L.

questionText: Fill in: A word meaning the center or most important part: N _ C L _ U S
explanation: NUCLEUS means the central part of something. N-U-C-L-E-U-S.

questionText: ACROSS: The act of breathing (10 letters): R _ S P _ R A T _ O N
explanation: RESPIRATION is the process of breathing. R-E-S-P-I-R-A-T-I-O-N.

questionText: Word game: What word can follow BLACK, GREEN, and OVER to make compound words?
explanation: BOARD connects: BLACKBOARD, GREENBOARD, OVERBOARD - all are valid compound words.

questionText: DOWN: A word meaning to put off until later (11 letters): P _ O C _ A S T _ N A T E
explanation: PROCRASTINATE means to delay or postpone action. P-R-O-C-R-A-S-T-I-N-A-T-E.

questionText: Fill in: A word meaning a person who receives something: R _ C _ P _ E N T
explanation: RECIPIENT is a person who receives something. R-E-C-I-P-I-E-N-T.

questionText: ACROSS: A fundamental truth on which others are based (9 letters): P _ I N C _ P L E
explanation: PRINCIPLE means a fundamental truth or proposition serving as a foundation. P-R-I-N-C-I-P-L-E.

questionText: Word game: What word can precede LINE, SIDE, and BOARD to make compound words?
explanation: TOUCH connects: TOUCHLINE, TOUCHSIDE is not common. SIDE: SEASIDE. Better - TOUCH: TOUCHLINE, SIDEBOARD, TOUCHDOWN. Actually SIDE: SIDELINE, SEASIDE - TOUCH: TOUCHLINE, TOUCHBOARD. Best is TOUCH: TOUCHLINE, TOUCHBOARD.
